description: Detect Safe Korea HTTP-200 emergency pages and invalid HTML responses; preserve the last successful safety-alert values on data-validation errors. Expose stale-data status and add offline regression checks for both implementations. Public version unchanged.

Fix the local standalone Korea Safety timestamp sensor to return an Asia/Seoul-aware datetime instead of a raw string. Validate correct UTC+09:00 offsets, invalid dates, empty data and unchanged message values. Public version unchanged.

Remove polling freshness attributes from standalone and incubator safety-alert sensors to prevent attribute-only state changes from repeating TTS announcements. Retain freshness metadata internally and cached-data fallback. Add stable-attribute regression coverage. Public version unchanged.

Add standalone safety-alert region options with current defaults, whole-region selection, validation, duplicate prevention and reload. Strengthen WARN/ERROR diagnostics in both safety-alert devices with initial failure, rate-limited stale-cache age and recovery logs. Add offline options checks. Public version unchanged.

Lower the Beautiful Soup requirement to >=4.9.3 in korea_incubator, korea_safety and the local korea_arisu manifest to allow coexistence with naver_weather's ==4.9.3 pin. Validate safety-alert regression checks and Arisu HTML extraction with Beautiful Soup 4.9.3 and SoupSieve 2.10 on Python 3.14. Public versions unchanged; live HA recovery remains unverified.
